name: arrows-diagonal-down-square
description: A diagonal double-headed resize arrow inside a square.
useCase: Indicate resizing along the falling diagonal axis.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The complete diagonal heads have shorter arms so their free ends stay separate at text size.

24.reason: The complete double-headed arrow keeps at least 1.5 pixels of clear space from its enclosing frame.
